title: level devil.exe
pitch: a troll platformer where the floor, the exit, the cursor and the taskbar all want you dead. 31 levels, a blue screen every death, infinite retries.
controls: ←→ / a d move · ↑ / w / space jump · r restart · esc levels · touch buttons on mobile
how_to: every level is a file that lies. if a floor, an exit or a checkpoint looks too easy, it probably is.
keep moving on stairs and bridges: some of them delete themselves behind you.
the controls can get swapped mid-level. watch which way you actually move, not which key you pressed.
deaths are free. r restarts the level instantly, esc opens the level list.
new speedrun starts from level 1 and times the whole run, deaths included.
